definition: Strongest adjacent positive log-density jump beyond 1.2 times the separately flow-selected termination candidate (when present), outside0.002pc and inside140pc; upstream state is a three-cell median and downstream state a four-cell median within a fixed native window (six cells before/seven after).10/50/90 linear-density crossings nearest the maximum gradient, interpolated only between adjacent native centers. Fractional native cell counts; no regridding or physical-thickness/convergence claim.
retained_legacy_definition: Original first-prominent-peak baseline-to-peak crossings remain in feature_diagnostics_initial/reviewed files; broad envelope widths are explicitly flagged and are not interchangeable with local_jump_v1.
